ops.entry: WHEN dispatching a fix DO brief the class contract — the invariant and its full state matrix — plus an explicit LEAVE list, never the instances reviewers measured. An instance brief closes one member per round; the LEAVE list stops a member re-judging what is already settled.
ops.why: Four rework rounds each closed only the measured instance; the cascade ended when the brief stated each class's contract and state matrix. Sharpens the same rule (rule over site survey) rather than adding a row.

ops.entry: WHEN validation has passed and a pull request is next DO run every CI step in a fresh clone on each CI interpreter version, diffing the environment against CI's — the validate matrix is not the CI step list, and scrubbing leaves variables the interpreter itself reads.
ops.why: A parity run in a scrubbed environment still missed a CI failure: the host set colour variables one interpreter version consults and only one version was run. Same rule, sharper acceptance.

Displaced: the repository-tier G-08 already carries the same guard workaround (content to a written file, repeated -m flags), and the guard is one repository's, so the craft copy was the weakest Gotcha.

ops.entry: WHEN a ruling grants a final rework round DO check before dispatching that its terminal condition defines each class by contract, rules where findings outside those classes go, and prescribes descope only where descope remedies the class — a silent condition turns every non-member finding into another escalation.
ops.why: A final round's condition was silent on non-member findings, so two mediums forced a further escalation and the prescribed descope remedied neither. I carry the condition into the fix and validate dispatches, so the check is mine before spending the round.

originals.original: WHEN dispatching a fix DO pass the discriminating RULE plus an explicit LEAVE list rather than a survey of sites. The LEAVE list does the work: unnamed near-misses are where a member spends a spawn re-judging what is already settled.

WHEN validation has passed and a pull request is next DO run every CI check step in a fresh clone with a scrubbed environment — the validate matrix is not the CI step list, so an audit no validator ran reddens the pull request instead.

WHEN a guard rejects a shell command for a redirect DO note that it masks quoted spans wholesale and misparses backslash continuations, and that a temp-file commit message is refused where repeated -m flags pass. Move content into a file written by the write tool and pass its path.
